-- 20240612093000_backfill_task_priority
-- Hand-written SQL. The Prisma schema is review-gated and not edited here.
-- Adds the priority column and backfills existing rows:
--   overdue         -> 'high'
--   still open      -> 'medium'
--   everything else -> 'low'

ALTER TABLE "tasks"
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "priority" TEXT;

UPDATE "tasks"
SET "priority" = CASE
    WHEN "dueAt" IS NOT NULL AND "dueAt" < NOW() THEN 'high'
    WHEN "status" = 'open' THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "tasks_priority_idx" ON "tasks" ("priority");
